skill.summary: 文案插图专家，为文章生成手绘风格插图。风格：手绘、简约、整洁、留白、构图平衡、色调统一。Use when user asks to generate illustrations for articles, "为文章配图", "生成插图", or needs hand-drawn style images for...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Simplified workflow and documentation for easier usage.
- Now automatically saves all outputs to `/tmp/imageGen/{YYYYMMDD}/{articleName}/`.
- Updated instructions for running scripts using bun and new parameters.
- Script auto-selects illustration density based on article content (default: per-section).
- Environment setup clarified: requires bun runtime and `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY`.
